narrationTexts: I'll look at the project first.
One bug. `orderTotal` tax computed on pre-discount `cents`, spec say tax on discounted amount.
finalText:
Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.

3 failures, all one bug in `src/pricing.js:41` `orderTotal`:

```js
const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);   // taxed pre-discount base
```

Taxed original `cents`, not discounted amount — contradict own doc comment above it. Only rows with both discount and tax non-zero exposed it (3 of 69 order-total rows); rest had a zero factor hiding it.

Fix:
```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Also drop `discounted + tax` structure — `applyTax` already round on way out, so no double-round drift.
